killedBy: drawArenaSchematic draws through a fake context, in the order and geometry a board needs
why: Fits the board to the box's width and anchors it at the corner, which is what a first draft of any fit-to-box routine does. A card comparing eight boards is then comparing eight differently-distorted pictures, and the distortion is largest on exactly the boards whose shape is the reason to pick them. Invisible to every other assertion in the repository: the call still returns true, the same number of rectangles is still painted, and the aspect check cannot be done in jsdom at all -- which is why the case that kills this runs a hand-rolled 2D context and measures the painted floor's ratio and margins rather than the scale factor.
